youtube_description:
Jesus... I'm the strong one for everyone. Tonight I cried in the bathroom so nobody would hear.

She's the one everyone calls when life falls apart. Tonight she cried in the bathroom so nobody would hear.

Her: Jesus... I'm the strong one for everyone. Tonight I cried in the bathroom so nobody would hear. 😭

Her: Three friends called me today with their problems. Nobody asked how I was.

Jesus: I heard you in that bathroom. You don't have to be quiet with Me.

Her: If I fall apart, who holds everyone else together?

Jesus: You were never meant to hold everyone together. That was always My job, not yours.

Her: But I don't know how to stop being the strong one.

Jesus: Start small. Tell one person the truth tonight: "I'm not okay." Strong people are allowed to be carried too.

"Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken."
Psalm 55:22 (BSB)

Jesus: Put it down. I've got you, and I've got them.
